# Controller-side Python deps for every Ansible job in deploy.yaml.

# ansible-core is pinned like the collections in each tree's requirements.yml:
# a version bump changes what a deploy does to live infra, so it moves in its
# own commit. One minor at a time: Renovate automerges patches, and opens each
# minor separately for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
